newsitem.title: GREECE: Short depos, forwards firmer, ecu/drs hugs 311.
newsitem.headline: Short depos, forwards firmer, ecu/drs hugs 311.

text.p: Greek short-term depos and forex forwards were firmer in early dealings on tighter overnight liquidity, ecu/drachma was hugging 311 and bonds were steady to lower, traders said.

"Short-term depos and forex forwards are up on tighter liquidity conditions," said a dealer at a private bank. "The rate outlook will improve if the Bank of Greece decides not to hold its 14-day depo tender on Wednesday."
The higher cost of funding was also affecting fixed coupon bonds but their prices were holding in early dealings.
"Bonds are little changed but the negative cost of carry will bite sooner or later unless short-term rates ease on better liquidity conditions," a bond dealer said.
The finance ministry raised 250 billion drachmas from the sale of 12-month T-bills featuring a gross rate of 9.60 percent, the ministry said.
The T-bills hit the market on Monday.
The drachma was slightly lower against the ecu hugging 311 in early dealings.
"Ecu/drachma is around 311 right now but it looks as if it is going to firm a bit more," said a forex dealer.
The mark was quoted at 159.34/39 from Monday's 159.575 fix, the dollar at 275.34/44 drachmas from 274.530 and the ecu at 311.04/14 from 310.810 drachmas.
